title: Ben-Gvir Releases Video Threatening to Kill Senior Hamas Figure Held in Israeli Prison
detail: Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir released a video threatening to kill a senior Hamas figure currently held in an Israeli prison, escalating incendiary rhetoric amid ongoing ceasefire tensions.

media.caption: Ben-Gvir releases video threatening senior Hamas prisoner held in Israel

title: Palestinian Death Toll in Gaza Continues to Rise Despite Ceasefire Declarations
detail: New reporting confirms the Palestinian death toll in Gaza continues to climb despite ceasefire declarations, with violence persisting on the ground.

title: Palestine Action Protesters Arrested Outside UK Labour Party Conference
detail: Palestine Action protesters were arrested outside the UK Labour Party conference as the UK government maintains its proscription of the group as a terrorist organisation.

media.caption: Palestine Action protesters arrested near UK Labour Party conference

title: BBC Reviews 53 Gaza-Based Journalists Over Alleged Terrorist Ties
detail: The BBC is reviewing 53 Gaza-based journalists over possible terrorist ties, raising significant press freedom and journalistic accountability questions. The review has drawn criticism from media freedom advocates who warn it could set a precedent for suppressing Palestinian journalistic voices during the ongoing conflict.
